title: Guest Messaging
intro: Send WhatsApp, SMS and email campaigns to guests who opted in to hear from you on your WiFi login page.

locked.title: Guest Messaging is an add-on
locked.body: Reach guests who opted in on your WiFi login page with WhatsApp, SMS and email offers. It is not part of your current plan.
locked.request: Ask your Wyfy Guest account manager to turn it on for your organisation.
locked.lapsed: Your Wyfy Guest licence is not active, so Guest Messaging is unavailable until it is renewed.

demo.banner: Demo workspace: sample guests, campaigns and numbers. Everything works, but nothing is actually sent, and your changes last only until you reload.
